The harness measures 129 builds/cycle at the same HEAD: the landed memos engage deterministically but NOT live (~1000x divergence). Two live-only defeat hypotheses delegated for DT attribution: (H1) the sync/async planning-answer memos are SINGLE-SLOT {versionKey, publisherNodeId} while the live seed alternates reads across five publishers — every alternation thrashes the slot and mints a fresh snapshot identity cascading through every downstream identity memo; (H2) the formation-phase retained-merge tail rebuilds from a fresh spread input per call (never exercised in the harness, which stores no active retained snapshot). Certification is luck-dependent on VM speed until closed. Evidence archived: data/examples/service-data-affinity-demo-archive/run-2026-08-15T20-13-05-841Z-natural-manual.tar.gz

claim: Independent verification approved the answer-memo and per-publisher-slot candidate a3f0aec3. The retained-state side-effect attack was closed structurally: the dominant store and clear paths live in getPriorityRecoveryPlanningAnswerSync OUTSIDE the memoized answer and still run per call (the wrapper's active branch re-stores with a fresh timestamp on every sync read and its clear check runs unconditionally), so memo hits skip only the Uncached-internal store on the async path, where the lapse is self-correcting — a grace expiry flips getActivePriorityRecoveryPlanningSnapshot to null, which changes retainedAtEntry and forces a rebuilding miss that re-stores, and reaching that point requires fifteen write-quiescent seconds including no heartbeat NODES writes while recovery is active, a contradictory regime; conversely any store or clear by another path changes the retained identity and forces a fresh merge, so no stale witness outlives pre-candidate-observable behavior. Cross-path coherence was independently re-verified by the 111-assertion sealed retention suite green with the candidate, whose fresher-async-across-sync-epoch-regression semantics are exactly what the retainedAtEntry key component preserves. Memory is bounded: the WeakMap outer keys GC with input snapshots, inner Maps and the per-publisher derivation Maps are bounded by cluster node count, and both new Maps are wired into both existing replacement clear sites matching the sibling-memo pattern. The per-publisher async promise slots never serialized executions before (the single slot lost entries on alternation while both derivations ran), and rejection clears are scoped per publisher with an entry-identity check that cannot clobber a newer entry. Red-first exactly as disclosed: the retained-merge and publisher-alternation tests fail at base while the per-node async answer test passes there and is honestly labeled characterization rather than red-first; byte-identical restore; 11-file battery 899 assertions green including all sealed suites; full 152-file control-plane glob at the same four pre-existing suite failures verified base-identical across prior rounds; all static gates green including complexity held at 1838 by the read/store helper split; thermal-gated before the heavy glob.
